topic.title: 은퇴 계획 논의
topic.description: 은퇴 계획 수립에 대한 기초적인 대화를 통해 저축의 중요성과 목표 설정을 배웁니다.

korean_scripts.korean_text: 안녕하세요, 은퇴 계획에 대해 이야기해 볼까요?
네, 좋아요. 제 생각에는 은퇴 자금을 얼마나 모아야 할지 잘 모르겠어요.
걱정 마세요. 일반적으로 은퇴 후 생활비의 70~80% 정도를 저축하라고 권장합니다.
그렇군요. 그럼 지금부터 꾸준히 저축하는 게 중요하겠네요.
맞아요. 그리고 은퇴 후 예상되는 생활 방식에 맞춰 계획을 세워야 합니다.
예를 들면 여행을 많이 다니고 싶으면 더 많은 돈이 필요하겠네요.
네, 맞습니다. 지금부터 구체적인 목표를 세우고 실천하는 것이 좋습니다.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Hello, shall we talk about retirement planning?
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Hello, | shall we talk about retirement planning?

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Yes, great. I'm not sure how much I need to save for retirement.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Yes, great. | I'm not sure | how much I need to save | for retirement.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Don't worry. Generally, it is recommended to save about 70-80% of your pre-retirement living expenses.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Don't worry. | Generally, it is recommended | to save about 70-80% | of your pre-retirement living expenses.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: I see. So, it’s important to save consistently from now on.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: I see. | So, it’s important | to save consistently | from now on.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: That's right. And you need to plan according to your expected lifestyle after retirement.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: That's right. | And you need to plan | according to your expected lifestyle | after retirement.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: For example, if I want to travel a lot, I'll need more money.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: For example, | if I want to travel a lot, | I'll need more money.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Yes, that's right. It’s good to set specific goals and act on them starting now.
